changes: Added a read-only Lattice CLI done_closure command that projects DONE readiness from the shared DONE oracle, registers the command as L0/read-only, and covers Authority receipt readiness without writing lifecycle or Authority artifacts.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js done_closure with storyId B-cd1e, or pass json true for machine-readable localNonAuthorityAudit and authorityServerPath output.
expectedOutcome: A TEST story can show validation PASS while still listing real DONE blockers such as delivery-check and story-summary, with Authority completion left unclaimed unless receipt-backed proof is verified.
actualTranscript: done_closure reported phase TEST, canAttemptDone false, readOnly true, localNonAuthorityAudit blocked, authorityServerPath receiptVerified false, mayClaimAuthorityDone false, and blockers delivery-check plus story-summary before closure artifacts were written. validate passed with 12 of 12 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: Actual matches expected: local closure is visible and conservative; no Authority Server completion is claimed from local evidence.
limitations: Authority Server receipt verification is not performed by done_closure; it only projects existing verified receipt refs and keeps mayClaimAuthorityDone false. flow-stability-smoke still has a pre-existing unrelated artifact_declare runtime-artifact failure, waived by delivery review.
pitfalls: Global lattice may not expose done_closure until this story is merged and built; use the story worktree dist CLI before merge. The command must use the no-write DONE oracle path so read-only runs do not append dirty-gate audit events.
